# Table of Contents

This live example uses the canonical component source in `packages/moyaforge-ui/src/components/`.

## Installation

Install the `table-of-contents` registry item through the MoyaForge CLI to copy editable component source and styles.

[UI Components](/ui)

## Usage

```tsx
<TableOfContents selector="h2[id], h3[id]" />
```

## Examples

## Styling

The installed component includes its source-owned CSS. Customize its styles in your application using scoped CSS selectors or the component's documented CSS variables. The example preview frame can be customized separately with `--mf-preview-border` and `--mf-preview-radius`.
